natural: A great vessel takes long to complete

meaning.en: Great talents mature late; a late bloomer.
meaning.zh: 大的器物需要长时间才能做成。比喻能担当重任的人要经过长期的锻炼，成就较晚。

equivalents: good things come to those who wait

examples.zh: 他四十岁才成名，是典型的大器晚成。
examples.en: He only became famous at forty — a classic late bloomer.

examples.zh: 别着急，大器晚成。
examples.en: Don't worry — great talents take time to mature.

story.en: Laozi: "The great square has no corners; the great vessel is completed late; the great sound is faint; the great image has no form" (大方无隅，大器晚成).
story.zh: 《老子》："大方无隅，大器晚成，大音希声，大象无形。"

usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语，常用于安慰。

meaning.en: To turn out in full force.
meaning.zh: 巢里的鸟全部飞出。比喻敌人出动全部兵力，也泛指全体出动。

examples.zh: 敌军倾巢出动，向我军发起进攻。
examples.en: The enemy came out in full force to attack.

examples.zh: 周末全家倾巢出动去郊游。
examples.en: At the weekend the whole family turned out for an outing.

usage.en: Predicate. Originally about enemies; now also humorous.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，原多指敌人，现也可诙谐使用。

natural: Reaching heaven in a single step

meaning.en: To reach the top in one leap (usually unrealistic).
meaning.zh: 一步就登上天。比喻一下子达到极高的境界或程度。

examples.zh: 学习要循序渐进，不可能一步登天。
examples.en: Learning is step by step — you can't get there in one leap.

examples.zh: 他想一步登天，结果被骗了。
examples.en: He wanted overnight success and got scammed.

usage.en: Predicate. Usually negated (不可能一步登天). In speech 一 is yí.

natural: At ease with it as with the ordinary

meaning.en: To take adversity calmly as if it were normal.
meaning.zh: 遇到困难或不顺利的情况，心情平静，像平常一样对待。

examples.zh: 生活条件很艰苦，他却安之若素。
examples.en: Living conditions were tough, but he took it in his stride.

examples.zh: 面对批评，她安之若素。
examples.en: She was unfazed by the criticism.

natural: Not pulling out a single hair

meaning.en: Extremely stingy; tight-fisted.
meaning.zh: 一根汗毛也不肯拔。形容为人非常吝啬自私。

examples.zh: 他很有钱，却一毛不拔。
examples.en: He's rich but tight-fisted.

examples.zh: 别指望那个一毛不拔的老板涨工资。
examples.en: Don't expect that stingy boss to give you a raise.

story.en: Mencius criticised Yang Zhu's egoism: "Even if pulling out one hair would benefit the whole world, he would not do it" (拔一毛而利天下，不为也).
story.zh: 《孟子》："杨子取为我，拔一毛而利天下，不为也。"

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. In speech 一 is yì.

meaning.en: To concede defeat sincerely; to acknowledge someone's superiority.
meaning.zh: 表示真心佩服，自认不如。

examples.zh: 你的棋下得太好了，我甘拜下风。
examples.en: You play chess so well — I concede.

examples.zh: 在厨艺上，我对她甘拜下风。
examples.en: When it comes to cooking, I take my hat off to her.

natural: Before the flowers and under the moon

meaning.en: A romantic setting for lovers.
meaning.zh: 花丛前，月光下。指环境幽美，适于谈情说爱的地方。

examples.zh: 恋爱不能只有花前月下，还要面对柴米油盐。
examples.en: Love isn't all moonlight and roses — there's daily life to face too.

examples.zh: 他们在花前月下许下誓言。
examples.en: They made their vows in a romantic moonlit garden.

meaning.en: A match made in heaven.
meaning.zh: 上天所成全的婚姻。多用作新婚的颂词。

examples.zh: 祝新郎新娘天作之合，白头偕老！
examples.en: To the bride and groom — a match made in heaven! May you grow old together.

examples.zh: 他们俩真是天作之合。
examples.en: They're made for each other.

story.en: The Book of Songs, on King Wen's marriage: "Heaven made the match" (天作之合).
story.zh: 《诗经·大明》："文王初载，天作之合。"

natural: Fragrance spreading for a hundred generations

meaning.en: To leave a good name for posterity.
meaning.zh: 好的名声永远流传下去。

examples.zh: 岳飞精忠报国，流芳百世。
examples.en: Yue Fei's loyalty to his country has gone down in history.

examples.zh: 他的善举将流芳百世。
examples.en: His good deeds will leave a lasting legacy.

origin.source: 南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·尤悔》

story.en: The ambitious general Huan Wen sighed: "If I can't leave a fragrance for later generations, can I not at least leave a stench for ten thousand years?"
story.zh: 桓温说："既不能流芳后世，亦不足复遗臭万载邪？"

usage.zh: 多作谓语。反义为"遗臭万年"。

meaning.en: Affected and unnatural; pretentious.
meaning.zh: 比喻故意做作，不自然。

examples.zh: 她说话矫揉造作，让人很不舒服。
examples.en: Her affected way of talking makes people uncomfortable.

examples.zh: 这首诗矫揉造作，缺乏真情。
examples.en: The poem is contrived and lacks real feeling.

natural: Toying with things and losing one's purpose

meaning.en: To lose sight of one's goals through indulgence in pastimes.
meaning.zh: 沉迷于所喜好的事物而丧失进取的志气。

examples.zh: 沉迷游戏会玩物丧志。
examples.en: Getting addicted to games will make you lose sight of your goals.

examples.zh: 爱好是好事，但不能玩物丧志。
examples.en: Hobbies are good, but don't let them derail your ambitions.

story.en: The Duke of Zhao warned King Wu not to be distracted by a fine hound from the west: "Toying with people ruins virtue; toying with things ruins ambition" (玩人丧德，玩物丧志).
story.zh: 《尚书·旅獒》："玩人丧德，玩物丧志。"

natural: Holding sand to shoot at shadows

meaning.en: To make insinuations; to attack someone indirectly.
meaning.zh: 比喻暗中攻击或陷害人。

examples.zh: 他在会上含沙射影地批评我。
examples.en: He made veiled attacks on me at the meeting.

examples.zh: 有话直说，别含沙射影。
examples.en: Say it straight — stop insinuating.

story.en: Legend tells of the yu (蜮), a water creature that spat sand at people's shadows, making them fall ill.
story.zh: 传说水中有一种叫蜮的怪物，含沙喷射人的影子，被射中的人会生病。

meaning.en: So happy somewhere that one forgets home or duty.
meaning.zh: 比喻在新环境中得到乐趣，不再想回到原来环境中去。

equivalents: having too much fun to come home

examples.zh: 他去海南度假，乐不思蜀。
examples.en: He went on holiday to Hainan and was having too much fun to come home.

examples.zh: 孩子在外婆家乐不思蜀。
examples.en: The child is having such a great time at Grandma's that he's forgotten all about home.

origin.source: 《三国志·蜀书·后主传》裴松之注引《汉晋春秋》

story.en: After Shu fell, its last ruler Liu Shan was taken to Luoyang. Asked by Sima Zhao if he missed Shu, he said: "I'm happy here; I don't miss Shu" (此间乐，不思蜀).
story.zh: 蜀亡后刘禅被送到洛阳，司马昭问他是否思念蜀国，刘禅说："此间乐，不思蜀。"

usage.zh: 多作谓语，现多诙谐使用。

meaning.en: Professed love for something one actually fears; all talk.
meaning.zh: 比喻口头上说爱好某种事物，实际上并不真爱好。

examples.zh: 他说喜欢运动，却从不锻炼，真是叶公好龙。
examples.en: He says he loves sport but never exercises — all talk.

examples.zh: 口口声声重视人才，却不给机会，是叶公好龙。
examples.en: Saying you value talent but giving it no chances is hollow.

story.en: Lord Ye loved dragons and decorated everything with them. A real dragon, touched, came to visit — and Lord Ye fled in terror.
story.zh: 叶公喜欢龙，家里到处画着龙。真龙知道后来访，叶公吓得魂飞魄散地逃走了。

usage.en: Predicate. 叶 was traditionally read shè here, now yè. 好 is hào.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。"叶"旧读 shè，今读 yè。"好"读 hào。

natural: Can't even recognise the character 丁

meaning.en: Illiterate.
meaning.zh: 形容一个字也不认识。

examples.zh: 他的祖父目不识丁，却很有智慧。
examples.en: His grandfather was illiterate but very wise.

examples.zh: 那时候很多农民目不识丁。
examples.en: Back then many peasants couldn't read or write.

story.en: The arrogant official Zhang Hongjing scorned soldiers: "Pulling a two-dan bow is no match for recognising a single 丁 character" (不如识一丁字) — 丁 being one of the simplest characters.
story.zh: 张弘靖斥责军士："今天下无事，汝辈挽得两石力弓，不如识一丁字。"

meaning.en: Puzzled; baffled.
meaning.zh: 心里迷糊不清，不能理解。

examples.zh: 他突然辞职，大家都迷惑不解。
examples.en: Everyone was baffled by his sudden resignation.

examples.zh: 这个现象让科学家迷惑不解。
examples.en: The phenomenon puzzled scientists.

meaning.en: A life of luxury.
meaning.zh: 精美的衣食。形容豪华奢侈的生活。

examples.zh: 她从小锦衣玉食，不知生活艰难。
examples.en: Raised in the lap of luxury, she knows nothing of hardship.

examples.zh: 锦衣玉食不一定带来幸福。
examples.en: Luxury doesn't necessarily bring happiness.

meaning.en: Restless with worry; unable to settle.
meaning.zh: 坐着躺着都不安宁。形容心情烦乱。

examples.zh: 孩子还没回来，妈妈坐卧不安。
examples.en: The child still isn't home, and Mum can't settle.

examples.zh: 他为这件事坐卧不安。
examples.en: He's been restless with worry over this.

meaning.en: To treat as equal; to put on a par (usually negated).
meaning.zh: 把不同的事物同等看待。

examples.zh: 业余比赛和职业比赛不能等量齐观。
examples.en: Amateur and professional competitions can't be put on a par.

examples.zh: 不能把这两件事等量齐观。
examples.en: You can't lump these two things together.

meaning.en: Time slips by.
meaning.zh: 指时间渐渐地过去了。

examples.zh: 光阴荏苒，转眼我们已经毕业二十年了。
examples.en: Time slips by — in the blink of an eye it's twenty years since we graduated.

examples.zh: 光阴荏苒，岁月如梭。
examples.en: The years roll by like a weaver's shuttle.

usage.en: Usually an opening clause. 荏苒 is rěnrǎn.

natural: Clothes and hat neat and fine

meaning.en: Smartly dressed.
meaning.zh: 衣帽穿戴得很整齐，很漂亮。

examples.zh: 他衣冠楚楚地出席了晚宴。
examples.en: He attended the dinner smartly dressed.

examples.zh: 别看他衣冠楚楚，其实是个骗子。
examples.en: He may be well turned out, but he's a con man.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial. Sometimes implies a respectable façade.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，有时暗示表里不一。

meaning.en: Disreputable friends; bad company.
meaning.zh: 比喻品行不端的朋友。

examples.zh: 他整天跟一帮狐朋狗友混在一起。
examples.en: He spends all day hanging out with a bad crowd.

examples.zh: 有钱时狐朋狗友一大堆，没钱时一个也不见。
examples.en: When he had money he had loads of dodgy friends; when it ran out, none were left.

natural: Not even chickens and dogs at peace

meaning.en: Total turmoil; such disturbance that even animals can't rest.
meaning.zh: 形容骚扰得很厉害，连鸡狗都不得安宁。

examples.zh: 装修吵得整栋楼鸡犬不宁。
examples.en: The renovation noise had the whole building in an uproar.

examples.zh: 他一喝醉，家里就鸡犬不宁。
examples.en: Whenever he gets drunk, all hell breaks loose at home.

story.en: Liu Zongyuan described tax collectors in the countryside: "Shouting east and west, causing uproar north and south... even chickens and dogs cannot find peace" (虽鸡狗不得宁焉).
story.zh: 柳宗元《捕蛇者说》："悍吏之来吾乡，叫嚣乎东西，隳突乎南北，哗然而骇者，虽鸡狗不得宁焉。"

meaning.en: Prematurely aged.
meaning.zh: 年纪不老，体力、精神就已衰退。

examples.zh: 长期熬夜让他未老先衰。
examples.en: Years of late nights have aged him before his time.

examples.zh: 才三十岁就满头白发，真是未老先衰。
examples.en: Grey-haired at thirty — old before his time.

meaning.en: To act as a villain's accomplice.
meaning.zh: 比喻充当恶人的帮凶，帮助恶人做坏事。

examples.zh: 他为虎作伥，帮黑社会收保护费。
examples.en: He's a henchman who collects protection money for the gang.

examples.zh: 我们绝不能为虎作伥。
examples.en: We must never become anyone's accomplice in wrongdoing.

story.en: Legend says a person killed by a tiger becomes a chang (伥) ghost, bound to serve the tiger and lure new victims to it.
story.zh: 传说被老虎咬死的人变成伥鬼，专门给老虎带路，引诱别人来让老虎吃。

usage.en: Predicate. 为 is wèi; 伥 is chāng.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。"为"读 wèi，"伥"读 chāng。
